component.name: Rollcopy
component.summary: Copy photos and videos from your iPhone over USB

description.p: Plug in your iPhone, pick photos and videos, and get files that open everywhere: HEIC becomes JPG and MOV becomes MP4 (lossless), arranged by the date each item was taken.

ul.li: Browse the library by year, month or album, with thumbnails, search and filters
Edited photos are copied as edited; Live Photos as stills, optionally with their motion
Shows what is already copied; one click copies everything new
Read-only towards the phone: it never changes or deletes anything there
Works offline; no account or cloud needed

description.p: Needs the usbmuxd service on your computer, which talks to the iPhone over USB. On Ubuntu or Linux Mint: sudo apt install usbmuxd

screenshot.caption: The library by year and month, with filters and the info pane

ul.li: Runs as a Flatpak: the iPhone is found when plugged in at any time, and again after re-plugging
In Flatpak, Open and Show in folder use the desktop portals, and no network access is needed
Notifications and the single-window check work in sandboxes on Ubuntu 24.04 and Linux Mint 22
New look: a sidebar with library, years, albums and the phone, a library bar with filter toggles, a larger info pane and a compact transfer dock
Sort by date, name, size or type
New app icon
iPhone 16 Spatial Audio videos convert; quitting stops conversions and leaves no half-written files
Fixes: a destination that can't be reached no longer hangs copying, Open shows the right photo, pairing stops asking for Trust over and over, free space counts copies already running
Search (Ctrl+F), zoomable thumbnails and month headings in the grid
Copy new: one click for everything not copied yet; overall progress with time left
Filters for favourites, Live Photos, screenshots and selfies
Viewer zoom and pan, details panel and Show in folder
Clickable notifications, a first-run guide, optional Live Photo motion as video
Copying to network shares opened in Files (and sshfs or FUSE drives) works
A phone that stops responding no longer stalls copying; it resumes by itself
Cancel also stops video and photo conversion straight away
Simpler tray icon with a clearer status dot
Clear messages when no app can open a file or the video player lacks codecs

description.p: Title bar and window buttons on GNOME (Wayland), such as Ubuntu; toolbar buttons no longer pushed out of view in narrow windows.
